label: negative
description: New variable feeBps is added before the reserved __gap array, and the gap shrinks from uint256[48] to uint256[47] so total occupied slots are unchanged.
why_labeled: This is the documented OpenZeppelin __gap pattern for adding storage to an upgradeable contract: the new variable consumes one reserved slot and the gap size is reduced by exactly one to match. Every pre-existing variable keeps its slot, and nothing after the gap moves. Textually feeBps is 'inserted before an existing variable' (__gap), so a placement-only detector that does not treat gap consumption specially fires falsely here.
